info.title: Tesserarr API
info.description: The token API of Tesserarr. Every request carries an API token as a bearer token; an operation lists the permission the token needs as the scope of `apiToken`. The web interface uses its own session API, which is not part of this document.

apiToken.description: An API token of a user (Settings > API tokens). The scopes of an operation name the permission the token must carry; the owner must hold it as well.
